t01:log-production-batchbatch-001clean conf 0.95—commitProduction-batch logging against a verified + registered aluminium-silicon die-cast batch. Governor-clean, and :log-production-batch is the only member of phase 3's :auto set -> auto-commit with no human in the loop.
t02:schedule-maintenancemnt-1clean conf 0.9approvedcommit after escalation :phase-approvalRefractory-inspection window against the verified + registered reverberatory furnace. Never auto-eligible at any phase -> escalates; the human plant supervisor approves.
t03:flag-safety-concernconcern-1escalate high-stakesapprovedcommit after escalation :requires-supervisor-approvalMolten-metal hazard concern. Always :coordination/safety-concern, so the governor escalates regardless of confidence; the human plant supervisor approves.
t04:coordinate-shipmentship-1clean conf 0.9approvedcommit after escalation :phase-approvalOutbound casting shipment against a verified + registered batch with real headroom (4000 of 20000 kg already shipped). Escalates; the human shipping approver approves and batch-001's own shipped weight advances.
t05:coordinate-shipmentship-2clean conf 0.9rejectedhold after escalation :phase-approvalA governor-clean shipment the human VETOES. Distinct from a HARD hold: the governor cleared it, a person did not. Lands on the ledger as :approval-rejected, basis :approver-rejected.
t06:coordinate-shipmentship-3HARD :batch-not-verifiednever offered (no interrupt)holdShipment against the seeded zinc-aluminium batch that has never been QC-verified and is not on file. HARD hold -- and the approval offered below is never reached, because a HARD hold does not pause for a human.
t07:coordinate-shipmentship-4HARD :shipment-weight-exceeded—holdShipment whose claimed weight would push batch-002 past its own logged production weight (2800 already shipped of 3000 kg, +1000 requested). The governor recomputes from the batch's own permanent fields rather than believing the claim. HARD hold.
t08:coordinate-shipmentship-5HARD :shipment-weight-exceeded—holdShipment stating no weight at all. Headroom cannot be recomputed, and un-checkable headroom is not headroom -- the governor refuses rather than falling through as 'not over capacity'. HARD hold.
t09:schedule-maintenancemnt-2HARD :equipment-not-verified—holdMaintenance against the seeded die-casting machine, which is neither inspected/commissioned nor registered. HARD hold.
t10:schedule-maintenancemnt-3HARD :furnace-actuate-blockednever offered (no interrupt)holdA maintenance proposal that tries to ACTUATE the melting furnace rather than draft a window. Permanent scope boundary -- it never reaches a human even though an approval is offered here. HARD hold.
t11:schedule-maintenancemnt-1HARD :already-scheduled—holdThe SAME maintenance window as t02, scheduled twice. Guarded off a dedicated :scheduled? fact, never a :status value. HARD hold.
t12:log-production-batchbatch-001HARD :invalid-alloy-grade—holdA batch patch declaring an alloy grade outside the closed non-ferrous casting-alloy set. HARD hold.
t13:log-production-batchbatch-001HARD :invalid-defect-rate—holdA batch patch claiming a defect rate above 100% -- a batch cannot reject more than all of its own output. HARD hold.
t14:log-production-batchbatch-001HARD :not-propose-effect—holdA mis-wired caller whose own request :effect is not :propose -- checked before anything else, so it can never reach a commit path. HARD hold.
t15:actuate-melting-furnacebatch-001HARD :unknown-op :furnace-control-blocked—holdAn op outside the closed four-op allowlist. Both the op allowlist and the proposal-effect allowlist reject it, so the ledger fact carries two rules. HARD hold.

Op gate contract (fixed)

Static description of this actor's closed four-op contract — the only hand-written content on this page. It states behaviour that is fixed in nonferrousmfg.governor and nonferrousmfg.phase, not anything measured in this run. The two tables below re-derive the same posture from those namespaces' own public vars, so the two can be compared.

OpGate
:log-production-batchmay auto-commit at phase 3 when governor-clean · alloy grade and defect rate re-validated against the closed known sets
:schedule-maintenanceALWAYS human approval · never in any phase's :auto set · equipment verified?/registered? re-derived independently · double-schedule guarded · direct furnace/die-casting/pouring-line actuation permanently blocked
:flag-safety-concernALWAYS human approval · :coordination/safety-concern is always high-stakes · never blocked on the referenced equipment being unverified — a hazard may be reported about anything
:coordinate-shipmentALWAYS human approval · never in any phase's :auto set · batch verified?/registered? re-derived independently · shipped weight recomputed from the batch's own logged production weight, never from the claim
